findings.description: While the airborne board holds a constant orientation (same tilt, trucks at the same ends, same face toward camera), its visible face switches from solid black to light natural wood within a single frame (~00:02.55-00:02.60), then reverts to dark by ~00:02.75. There is no rotation that could expose a different face, so the board's surface swaps appearance spontaneously.

In the first trick (00:01.75-00:02.5) the truck side of the board is solid black; in the second trick (00:08.25-00:08.75) the truck side of the same board in the same continuous take is light grey/white. The board's underside graphic changed with no cut or board swap shown.
